generation_note: Prompts are requests, not verified transcripts, pitches or event times. Task IDs identify existing raw assets; no signed download URLs are retained.

editing.first_stage: FFmpeg atempo per landmark interval, pitch-preserving WSOLA, followed by exact-length tail padding/trimming
editing.second_stage: Advance internal segments by the measured envelope delay minus 2 ms; linear crossfade the overlap. Retain initial consonants.

export.delivery: libmp3lame 320 kbps MP3 with Xing gapless header and TBPM tag

verification_limits: Internal offsets are forward envelope proxies, not independent auditory validation. Raw audio and source isolation must be retained to reproduce the edits. Final decoder is Groove minimp3_ex.
